pin_rule: Must be pinned by immutable digest (python@sha256:<64 hex>) and by image ID (sha256:<64 hex>). A tag alone is never accepted.
python_note: Verified statically (Gate 1c): /usr/local/bin/python3 is a symlink to python3.12 (Python 3.12.16, an AArch64 ELF) on the image's root filesystem, not on a tmpfs the agent could rewrite. Not executed: that it starts as the chosen numeric uid is verified in a later gate.
user_note: RECORDED: uid 10001 and gid 10001, approved by the project owner and used by every step for the gateway: the container user, the owner of its tmpfs mounts, the exec user for extraction, verification and the gateway process, and the owner check on the injected tree. They are distinct from the agent's verified identity (config/agent_identity.json). Evidence: the image's /etc/passwd lists only root, the standard Debian system accounts and nobody (no uid 10001, and no primary gid 10001 on any account). Its /etc/group was not captured in the Gate 1c report, so that no group named 10001 exists is an inference from standard Debian base groups, not an observation; a numeric gid needs no group entry either way. The image has no passwd entry for this uid, so the gateway's environment supplies HOME=/tmp.
entrypoint_note: The create request sets exactly this entrypoint and command (policy-validated and re-checked at inspect), so no entrypoint of the base image is ever run.
declared_volumes_note: Verified (Gate 1c): the image config declares no Volumes, so no extra tmpfs is needed to neutralise one.
